run_AffinityPropagation: run AffinityPropagation clustering on sample data with preference and random_state parameters
create_make_blobs: create sample clustered data using make_blobs with centers, n_samples, and cluster_std
test_homogeneity_score: test clustering quality with homogeneity_score comparing true labels to predicted labels
test_silhouette_score: test clustering quality with silhouette_score using sqeuclidean metric on data and labels
test_adjusted_rand_score: test clustering quality with adjusted_rand_score comparing true labels to predicted labels
